answer_1.quote: We focus on another type of multilingual task: simultaneous interpreting.
answer_1.outputs: The paper focuses on simultaneous interpreting, which involves translating speech in real-time, and introduces the MockConf dataset with span- and word-level alignments for evaluating such systems.

answer_2.quote: We compute the proportion of exact matches for span alignment, which we call Exact match... We also define an approximate span alignment error... We report Alignment Error Rate (AER) and F 1 macro-averaged over all recordings.

answer_4.quote: We recruited 5 professional translators, all of them native Czech speakers, who were paid 200 CZK per hour.
answer_4.guideline: The annotator guidelines as well as the precise definitions of labels are in Appendix D; the activity of each annotator is in Table .
